title: TradingView Replay

launchpad.outcome: Learn TradingView Replay, then run the same workflow in AGHF Replay with the future locked.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Can I decide without the next candle?

slides.title: Replay in TradingView
steps: Click Replay. Pick a date and start before the session.
Read the 4H, map the 1H, watch the 15M.
Step Forward one candle at a time. Never jump ahead.
Each candle: TAKE · WAIT · PASS. Taking it? Set stop and target first.
Log the result in your AGHF journal.

slides.title: Now practice it in AGHF Replay
lines: Same workflow. Drag the time slider forward to see what a backtest does with the future.
slides.principle: Replay should feel a little uncomfortable. Uncertainty is what you’re practicing.

takeaways: Start before the session; hide the future.
TAKE · WAIT · PASS at each candle.
remember: Replay should feel a little uncomfortable.
